subject: Staggered host laddering for co-sell demo (CloudForge / AWS / GCP)
messages:
From: Simon Park <simon@cloudforge.io>

Cc: Amy Cole <amy.cole@amazon.com>, GCP SI <gcp-schedule@stacklift.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: multi-region co-sell demo - laddered hosts

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking the lead here. CloudForge is ready to move forward with the joint co-sell demo for the Prospect (Zephyr Labs). We have stakeholders in NA and EMEA and want a single 60-minute session that shows Redwood on AWS, then a failover/routing example to GCP, with our SI (CloudForge) demonstrating integration.

Key asks:
- Can we ladder hosts so AWS hosts first 25-30 minutes, GCP hosts the middle section, then a short wrap on Redwood console?
- Who owns the recording and the public-facing recording link?
- Need to confirm recording capture (who starts/stops + where the recording is stored) and a runbook for cutover points.

Availability window (Pacific tz): Jul 8 - Jul 12, mornings preferred (10:00 - 13:00 PT).

Simon
Simon Park
Partnerships, CloudForge

Simon — thanks, this is doable. Quick proposal:

Option A (preferred):
- 60-minute window, laddered hosts in 3 blocks: AWS 0-25m, GCP 25-45m, Redwood console + Q&A 45-60m.
- Recording owner: Redwood will host the recording in our secure S3/Drive and provide a single link; CloudForge may mirror to their collateral repo after we publish.
- Cutover runbook: short runbook for host handoff + two fallback hosts (one from AWS, one from GCP).

Option B (if we need to compress): 45-minute compact run with AWS 0-20m, GCP 20-35m, 35-45m wrap.

Please confirm: which slot in Jul 8-12 mornings works best for all. Also confirm presenters (names + roles) so we set the speaker order.

Folks — attaching a first-pass runbook and a proposed slot matrix (see attachments). Highlights and recommendations:

1) Host laddering approach (recommended):
   - Block 1 (AWS) 10:00-10:25 PT: core Redwood on AWS + CloudForge integration kickoff. AWS hosts – they start recording.
   - Block 2 (GCP) 10:25-10:45 PT: GCP takes the live integration demo, show failover/routing. GCP hosts – ensure listener handoff.
   - Block 3 (Redwood wrap) 10:45-11:00 PT: cross-region troubleshooting + Q&A; Redwood hosts and stops recording.

2) Recording ownership: Redwood will store the canonical recording. AWS and CloudForge get access link after processing (we'll add retention metadata).

3) Ops backchannel: create a short-lived Slack channel + Zoom co-host bridge. Marcus will be the host backup if a presenter drops.

4) Fallbacks and recovery: If handoff fails, immediate fallback is to move to pre-recorded short clip (1-2 min) and continue to next block; the runbook has explicit steps.

Attachments: redwood_runbook_draft_v1.pdf, proposed_slot_matrix.xlsx

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
